description: SBI received alerts about the suspected exposure on October 16 from its Threat Intelligence Service Provider, the Defence Cyber Agency and CERT-In. Its preliminary review covered around 375,000 records available on the dark web, of which 3,897 contained personally identifiable information. The exposed details reportedly included names, contact information, residential addresses and identifiers linked to branches and loan records. SBI activated its cyber incident response procedures and appointed an independent CERT-In-empanelled agency to investigate the incident and assess potential risks.
title: SBI Reports Suspected Data Exposure Affecting 3,897 Customer Records

description: Bank Negara Malaysia has introduced SSDS+, a distributed ledger technology-based platform for issuing, depositing, and safeguarding tokenised bonds and Islamic sukuk. Integrated with the RENTAS+ settlement system, it enables securities transactions and payments around the clock using central bank money. The infrastructure is designed for wholesale markets and could support the tokenisation of government securities and corporate bonds.
title: Malaysia Rolls Out Tokenised Bond Platform for Around-the-Clock Settlement

description: Infinix GT 50 Pro will launch in India on October 27 with three gaming accessories included in a single bundle. The GT NX Controller will support handheld and compatible two-player gaming, while the GT NX Station will enable gameplay on compatible TVs and monitors at up to 4K resolution and 60Hz. The GT MagCharge Cooler 2.0 will combine thermoelectric cooling with wireless charging. The smartphone will feature a Dimensity 8400 Ultimate chipset, a 144Hz AMOLED display and a 6,500mAh battery.
title: Infinix GT 50 Pro Gaming Bundle Revealed Ahead of October 27 India Launch

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is estimated to have generated $630 million in revenue from pre-orders already. According to a data analytics firm, the game has sold over 6 million copies through pre-orders on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. GTA 6 is set to launch on November 19, 2026. It is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time.
title: GTA 6 Is Estimated to Have Generated $630 Million From Pre-Orders Already

description: Qubic has resumed its layer-1 blockchain after halting operations to contain a wallet seed generation vulnerability that led to the theft of approximately $1.4 million in QU tokens from 1,404 accounts. The project said its Computor quorum approved a recovery plan, and the first payment has been made. The amount paid and the number of approved claims have not been disclosed.
title: Qubic Brings Blockchain Back Online After $1.4 Million Attack, Sets Recovery Claim Window

description: Motorola's rumoured wide-folding smartphone has been listed on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the moniker Motorola Razr Flex 27. The listing reveals that the foldable will be powered by a chipset with the model number QTI SM8845. This model number belongs to the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC from Qualcomm, which also powers the Motorola Signature and some mid-range phones from other OEMs, like OnePlus and iQOO. According to the listing, the chipset of the Motorola Razr Flex 27 will feature six efficiency cores clocked at 3.4GHz and two performance cores, which deliver a peak clock speed of up to 3.8GHz. The phone also appears to have 10.96GB of RAM, which could be marketed as 12GB of RAM.
title: Motorola Razr Flex 27 Chipset and Other Specifications Revealed via Geekbench Listing Ahead of Launch

description: Infinix has been launching plenty of smartphones in India lately. The company recently debuted the Infinix Note Edge, equipped with a slim design, a curved AMOLED screen, and a relatively large battery pack. A limited-edition variant of the smartphone has now been launched. Called the Infinix Note JBL Edition, it brings a couple of changes to an otherwise familiar package. The new model gets a Solar Orange finish and JBL-tuned stereo speakers, while the rest of the specifications are familiar.
title: Infinix Note Edge JBL Edition First Impressions

description: eMudhra has started taking remedial action after researchers found eight compromised CA certificates with weak keys. On Monday, a member of Mozilla’s Cryptography Engineering team, Dennis Jackson, wrote that eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised. The CA certificates are used by the root programmes of Mozilla, Microsoft, Apple, and Chrome, among other firms. He said that the issue was first reported on October 17 to the Root Program Team wth the private keys of the eight CA certificates of eMudhra. The eight CA certificates were created in April last year as part of its Key Generation Ceremony within its public infrastructure, eMudhra pointed out. Further, the company assured that seven of the eight affected certificates were not deployed in production. The one certificate that was deployed has never been used to issue end-entity certificates.
title: eMudhra Takes Remedial Action After Security Researcher Flags Weak Intermediate CA Keys

description: The Oppo Reno 17 Pro is tipped to feature a 6.32-inch display with a 1.5K resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate, alongside a MediaTek Dimensity 8550 Super chipset. Its rumoured camera setup includes a 200-megapixel primary sensor, two 50-megapixel rear cameras and a 50-megapixel front camera. The handset could also pack a 7,000mAh battery. The Reno 17 series may debut in China in November with Android 17-based ColorOS 17, followed by an India launch in early 2027, without the Pro model.
title: Oppo Reno 17 Pro Camera, Display and Battery Specifications Surface Online Ahead of Expected Launch

description: Perplexity Computer supports two processing modes on Mac: Hybrid Compute, which combines cloud-based reasoning with local handling of private data, and a fully local option. Users can run local tasks with Qwen 3.6 or PPLX Pro and allow cloud access when they need current information or connected apps. Computer can also work across Notes, Messages, Mail and other supported apps. The feature includes sandboxed code execution and is available to Pro, Max and Enterprise subscribers on compatible Apple silicon Macs.
title: Perplexity Computer for Mac Adds Local AI Mode for Pro, Max Subscribers

description: MoonPay and Dunamu, the operator of the South Korean crypto exchange Upbit, have signed a strategic collaboration agreement to explore international stablecoin payments and corporate digital asset infrastructure. The partnership will also examine access to GIWA services. No commercial terms or launch timeline have been announced, as both companies are still assessing the technical and commercial feasibility of the proposed solutions.
title: Upbit Operator Dunamu Partners With MoonPay to Advance Stablecoin Payment Solutions

description: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 released on Netflix on October 20. Now, Cyberpunk 2077 is getting a free update to coincide with the release of the anime. Update 2.5 will feature content inspired by Edgerunners 2 along with a few new features, including cyberware customisation and a new dual-wielding playstyle.
title: Cyberpunk 2077 Is Getting a Free Update This Week to Mark the Release of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 on Netflix

description: Strive increased its Bitcoin holdings to 36,818 BTC, while US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $526.6 million in inflows on October 19. However, subsequent outflows and uncertainty over interest rates continue to cloud the outlook for a sustained recovery.
title: Bitcoin Trades at $83,000 as Strive Adds 1,223 BTC to Holdings

description: Oppo wide-folding phone will be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9600M chipset, according to a tipster. The MediaTek SoC features four ARM C1-Pro efficiency cores 2.7GHz, three ARM C1-Premium performance cores clocked at 3.5GHz, and a prime ARM C1-Ultra core delivering a peak clock speed of up to 4.21GHz. The chipset also powers the recently launched Vivo X500 and Oppo Find X10. Apart from this, the leaker says that the Oppo wide-folding phone will pack an 8,000mAh battery. For optics, the rumoured Oppo wide-folding smartphone will reportedly be equipped with a dual rear camera unit. It might sport a 200-megapixel primary camera with a Samsung HPE sensor, paired with a 200-megapixel secondary camera with a Samsung HP5 sensor.
title: Oppo Wide-Folding Phone Tipped to Feature New MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Series Chipset: Expected Specifications

description: OpenAI announced a new privacy feature for ChatGPT on Wednesday. Called Locked Chats, it lets users protect select conversations from being viewed by others who may have access to their devices. The San Francisco-based AI company said that Locked Chats moves conversations out of the regular chat history and search results into a protected section that requires authentication for access. Users can secure conversations with a four-digit PIN or use biometric authentication on supported devices.
title: ChatGPT Locked Chats Feature to Hide Sensitive Conversations Rolling Out to Free, Plus and Other Users

description: OnePlus China President Li Jie has detailed the active cooling system expected to debut with the Ace 7 series. The setup uses two airflow channels to cool the chipset and rear panel, while the intake and exhaust placements aim to prevent blocked airflow and reduce discomfort during gaming. The lineup is expected to include the Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro. Both models are tipped to feature Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 series chipsets and 9,000mAh batteries, alongside 185Hz displays.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 Series to Get Active Cooling With Dual Airflow Design

description: Microsoft is reportedly planning to launch the next-generation Xbox console, Project Helix, by the holiday season in 2028. The price of the device could be between $1,200 and $1,800, according to internal projections at the company. A next-generation Xbox handheld will reportedly launch in 2027.
title: Next-Generation Xbox Will Reportedly Launch in 2028, Could Cost Between $1,200 and $1,800

description: Realme C01 could be launched soon, as the smartphone has been spotted on a retailer website in Vietnam. In terms of specifications, the Realme C01 appears to feature a 6.8-inch HD+ (720 x 1,520 pixels) LCD touchscreen, delivering up to a 120Hz refresh rate and up to 900 nits peak brightness. The screen will ship with Panda Glass protection. The smartphone will be powered by an octa-core Unisoc T7250 chipset, which features six efficiency cores clocked at 1.6GHz and two performance cores, delivering a clock speed of up to 1.8GHz. The Realme C01 is also shown to feature an ARM Mali-G57 GPU, along with 4GB of RAM and 64GB of internal storage, which is expandable via a microSD card. For optics, the Realme C01 is listed with a single 8-megapixel camera on the back, paired with a 5-megapixel front-facing camera for selfies and video calls. The handset could support up to 1080p/ 30 fps video recording. It will ship with an unspecified Android 16-based ColorOS or Realme UI version.
title: Realme C01 Price, Colour Options and Key Specifications Revealed via Retailer’s Website Ahead of Launch

description: After launching its Redmi K100 Pro and K100 Pro Max, all eyes are on the Redmi K100 as it nears its October 26 launch in China. New details have emerged, revealing its primary camera’s resolution and aperture. The phone will also feature an IP68 rating and an in-display fingerprint reader.
title: Redmi K100 Confirmed to Get a 50-Megapixel Rear Camera and In-Display Fingerprint Reader

description: Poco X8s has been launched in select global markets. The new smartphone is currently on sale in Vietnam via Shopee. The Poco X8s is offered in Black, Blue, and White colourways. The Poco X8s is a dual-SIM smartphone. It ships with Xiaomi’s HyperOS 3, which is based on Android 16. The smartphone sports a 6.35-inch 1.5K (1,220 x 2,656 pixels) AMOLED display, offering up to a 120Hz refresh rate and up to 3,500 nits peak brightness. Powering the Poco X8s is Qualcomm’s octa-core Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset, which is built on a 4nm process. It features four efficiency cores clocked at up to 1.8GHz, three performance cores clocked at up to 2.4GHz, and a prime core, delivering a peak clock speed of up to 2.8GHz.
title: Poco X8s Launched With 6,330mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Karbonn Mobiles is a familiar name that has been largely absent from the Indian smartphone market for several years now. The brand’s last major smartphone launch was in 2019, following which its operations ceased. However, it appears to be preparing a comeback with a new 5G smartphone, dubbed the Karbonn Rebel 5G. The launch of the upcoming handset in India has been teased via a dedicated microsite on an e-commerce platform.
title: Karbonn Rebel 5G India Launch Teased via Amazon, Signalling the Homegrown Brand's Comeback

description: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max will be launched on October 22 as India's first phone to be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, the company has announced. The SoC features two prime cores, delivering a peak clock speed of up to 4.55GHz. Further, the company has confirmed that the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max’s chipset will be coupled with Oppo’s Laminar Flow Engine. This means that the handset will ship with Android 17-based ColorOS 17, making the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max India’s first phone to ship with the software. Recently, Oppo announced that the flagship smartphone will debut in India with the Industry-first Hasselblad-tuned triple 200-megapixel camera system, with the LUMO Hyper Pixel and LUMO True Image engines.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max Will Launch as India’s First Phone With the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro Chipset

description: The official listing confirms that the Lava Aura Curve sports a 6.67-inch full-HD+ 3D curved AMOLED screen, a MediaTek Dimensity 7100 SoC, a 6,000mAh battery and a secondary mini rear display. It comes with a 50-megapixel back camera and a 13-megapixel selfie shooter. The latest phone, available for purchase through offline retailers in India, shares similarities with the Lava Virat Curve introduced last month.
title: Lava Aura Curve Key Features, Colour Options Revealed on Official Website Ahead of India Launch

description: Amid news about limited iPhone Duo devices available in retail stores on launch day, there’s more bad news for those pre-ordering the new foldable. Apple has limited iPhone Duo pre-orders to two per customer, according to a recent report. Customers could previously add more than two units when pre-orders went live on October 16.
title: Apple Limiting iPhone Duo Pre-Orders to Two Units per Customer in the US

description: The Xiaomi 18 series is expected to make its global debut soon, following its launch in China in September. Ahead of the unveiling, a recently surfaced leak sheds light on the battery capacities of the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max. The report suggests that buyers outside China may have to settle for smaller batteries than those offered by the domestic variants. The Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max are also tipped to carry higher price tags in Europe.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro, Xiaomi 18 Pro Max Global Variants to Reportedly Get Smaller Batteries, Higher Price Tag

description: The Galaxy S27 series is expected to arrive in 2027 as Samsung’s next–generation flagship lineup. In recent weeks, details about their displays, designs, and hardware configurations have already begun to surface online. The lineup is rumoured to comprise four models, with Galaxy S27 Ultra sitting at the top. Newly surfaced screen protector images offer a closer look at the expected form factors of three upcoming handsets. Meanwhile, a tipster has also talked about rising component costs influencing memory configurations, storage options, and pricing of Samsung's upcoming flagships.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Series Display Sizes Tipped by Leaked Screen Protectors; Storage Configurations Surface

description: Motorola’s budget-focused G-series could be expanded with a new model. According to a tipster, the launch of the Moto G47 5G is on the cards for the European market. While an official announcement has yet to be made, details about the handset, including its design, key specifications, and price, have surfaced online. It is said to feature a MediaTek chipset and a 7,000mAh battery. The purported Moto G47 5G could ship with Android 16 out of the box.
title: Moto G47 Power 5G May Feature Dimensity 6300 SoC, 108-Megapixel Camera; Price Tipped
